visualCharacteristics: Vertical list of collapsible Q&A rows separated by thin 1px dividers. Each row shows a bold question label with a '+' toggle icon on the right that becomes '−' when expanded, revealing the answer body below.
contentPattern: Each row has two cells: [ question | answer ]. Question is the summary label; answer is the collapsible body.
usage: FAQ and Q&A sections. Used by faq-page and the homepage-landing FAQ section.
